claims.text: Begin an unfamiliar crafting task by running the craft help operation to discover the available interface before committing materials.
Use inventory checks and table-placement operations to inspect or prepare the crafting state before invoking the irreversible craft operation.
Invoke the craft operation only after the table is prepared, then check inventory to confirm that the target object is being held.
The stone_pickaxe is the target object that must be crafted and held before the task is complete.
The craft operation is irreversible and consumes whatever materials are currently on the table, so exploratory state checks should precede the final craft.
In the unfamiliar-workshop scenario, the agent successfully used the craft tools to craft and hold a stone_pickaxe, then reported completion in one line.
Treat the task as complete only when inventory verification confirms that one stone_pickaxe is held; report that result briefly and stop.
